rule: Altitude tripwire (set Nov 4, 2026, research/stats_catalog/ALTITUDE_TRIPWIRE.md): diff = mean(final - DK opener) at Denver/Utah home games minus the same for all other games this season. All-Star break: drop the +3.8 to 0 only if diff < -2.0, otherwise no change. Season end: diff >= +2.0 keep +3.8; 0 to +2.0 halve to +1.9; below 0 drop to 0.
